text:
sara-marketing: Quick idea — run a small pricing page experiment next week that ties 3 things together: 1) ultra-short FAQ microvideos (7–12s each) inline, 2) a stripped-down cost calculator, and 3) a gated webinar CTA for high-intent results. Want to capture better qual for inbound without killing CTAs. Thoughts?

tom-growth: love the bundle. two quick variants: A = videos inline + open calc (no form), B = videos in-hover + calc behind email gate + webinar gate for high estimates. test primary CTA phrasing too.

sam-ux: keep the calc tiny — just `monthly_usage`, `avg_sequence_len`, `commit_tier` slider. don't ask for full contact profile on first touch. email + company_size bucket is enough.

sara-marketing: +1 on minimal fields. primary KPI = demo requests / conversion from calc submit. secondary = webinar signups routed to sales.

elaine-pd: quick note on messaging: microvideos should address 3 common confusion points: what costs scale with (tokens vs requests), benefit of dedicated, and how caching affects price. callouts should be microcopy, not deep dives.

nick-sales: routing ask: if company_size >= 200 OR calc_estimate >= $5k/mo => route to enterprise queue (nick-sales). else -> inbound SDR pool. Can we add `lead_score` tags for marketing automation?

chris-analytics: Metrics checklist I need: pageviews -> video play %, calc opens, calc submits, email capture rate, webinar signup -> demo conversion, avg_estimate_by_segment. Also track cohort by `region` and `channel` (paid vs organic). We'll need UTM passthrough from paid.

sam-ux: mock HTML snippet for calc (very rough):
```html
<form id="pricing-calc-v1">
  <input name="email" type="email" placeholder="email@example.com">
  <select name="company_size">
    <option value="1-10">1-10</option>
    <option value="11-50">11-50</option>
    <option value="51-199">51-199</option>
    <option value="200+">200+</option>
  </select>
  <input name="monthly_tokens" type="number" min="0">
  <button type="submit">Get estimate</button>
</form>
```

sara-marketing: routing flow proposal: calc_submit -> webhook -> zapier -> marketing automation (tag) + sales routing. If `enterprise` tag => create SFDC lead with `Priority: P1` and assign to nick-sales. Else create lead in SDR queue w/ `Priority: P3`.

nick-sales: ok for zapier. prefer a short note field `calc_note` with the main driver (tokens or seq_len) so AE has context.

elaine-pd: for the FAQ videos, script backlog (one-liners):
- pricing_basics: "Costs are mostly per-token; think of requests like API calls — cache and batching reduce per-token cost."
- dedicated_value: "Reserved capacity gives predictable latency and throughput — good for production SLAs."
- quantization_tradeoffs: "Quantization lowers cost with small accuracy tradeoffs — we'll suggest profiles by workload."

tom-growth: experiment timeline: prep this week, dev deploy canary Tuesday, run 2 weeks, analyze on 14-day window. go/no-go thresholds: +8% calc->demo or +12% webinar->demo.

chris-analytics: can run Bayesian lift test if we keep sample size targets — estimate needing ~8k pageviews/week to hit power for calc->demo lift. will confirm.

webinar-bot: Reminder: gated webinar variant is scheduled for 2026-06-09 10:00 UTC if we enable gating. :bell:

sam-ux: small UX ask — show calc result inline (estimate + recommended tier + CTA buttons: 'Start free trial' and 'Book demo'). keep CTA above the fold after submit.

elaine-pd: content cadence: script -> record -> edit (3 microvideos) in 3 business days. marketing to own captions + alt text.

sara-marketing: next steps: 1) sam to drop prod-ready snippet and mock by EOD, 2) chris confirm power calc tomorrow, 3) tom to set experiment in Growthboard, 4) nick confirm SFDC mappings. tagging folks: @sam-ux @chris-analytics @nick-sales @tom-growth.

tom-growth: noted, I'll create the experiment ticket and link it here. :thumbsup:

nick-sales: will confirm SFDC field names today and reply here.

chris-analytics: will post sample-size calc and event spec by 12pm PT tomorrow.

sara-marketing: great — thanks team. aim to launch Tuesday canary and monitor for signs of funnel drop (calc friction). :rocket:
